nom: AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid AHA

avis.texte: I'm such a big fan of nourishing skin so when my sister-n- law recommended this brand to me I had to purchase it. This product didn't disappoint, it's nourishing, silky, and light-weight keeping my skin soft and glowy. If I could recommend this product over and over I would. -

I began using this lotion back in January this year, and when I say it has completely transformed the texture of my skin, I am not exaggerating. My skin has never been so soft while only using one body product. I'm obsessed and I have it on auto replenish. a must have!

This review is part of an ad campaign. However, I did try it and actually like the product. I do feel like my skin is less dry and dull. It's smoother and softer feeling. I do recommend using this product, especially at night time before bed. You won't regret it!

avis.titre: I will continue to buy this until I die
avis.texte: This is by far the absolute best lotion I have ever used! And I love that you can apply on your face as well! 100/10!!

I absolutely love this product! It's gentle enough to use everyday without being too abrasive. I use it in the pm and wake up with the softest skin! and no irritation even with my sensitive skin. I highly reccomend!

This product is so good, very moisturizing and helps with my skin texture. I would definitely be repurchasing this particular product and explore more from the brand. I'd need advice too on which particular product I can buy please if there's anyone to share or I can just get all 🤭

avis.titre: I like this product very much.
avis.texte: The one thing and there are many things I like about this product is it is fragrance free. It is very moisturizing without feeling greasy.
Love this so much! It really helps with my KP skin an noticed such a huge difference
Really good for dry skin, makes my skin soft and hydrated the next morning. Love it everyday.

It came into my life at just the right moment, when I didn't know what else to use to improve the appearance of my skin. From the very first application, I noticed a dramatic improvement in my skin's texture, now it feels more hydrated, softer, and looks healthier 🥹

I love this for my KP prone arms! Really helps to decrease the bumps and redness over time and even works to make my excessively dry hands softer and less red. The smell is pretty much nothing, not like it used to be! and it soaks in quickly so it doesn't feel greasy

This body lotion is great for gentle exfoliation and dry skin. Woke up the next morning with dry patches gone and glowing skin, it's really lightweight.
Makes my skin super smooth. Helps fade dark spots and makes my skin glow. Love it

This body lotion makes my skin glow and is perfect for anyone with KP

Its been an incredibly hot and dry winter in LA; my skin feels dry, dehydrated and flaky. Adding amlactin daily nourish back to my routin has been the only thing that has helped my skin. Be consistent and you will get results.
Makes my skin super smooth and soft! Helped a lot with dry, rough texture. Smell isn't the best and it can sting a bit, but it works. Would repurchase

This lotion has seriously improved my KP over time. My skin feels smoother, less bumpy, and way more hydrated. It can tingle a bit at first, but the results are worth it. I keep reaching for it daily.
I like this daily lotion because it keeps my skin soft without feeling greasy. It absorbs fast and works well after a shower. Good for everyday use and keeps my skin from feeling dry.

This is the only moisturizer that helps me with KP. It is very nourishing and brightening.
My new favorite daily lotion. Its fragrance free, lightweight, non greasy, its great fir eczema prime skin.
I've been using this cream for many years, I use it every night on my feet and lower body

My legs are so soft, my skin actually stays hydrated and almost shiny throughout the day, and most of all the appearance of my KP has significantly reduced. It didn't go away entirely, but overall I'm really happy with the results. The only con is that it smells kind of funny, but that doesn't linger very long.
This lotion is so good. I use it daily and my skin has never been softer. I got it for kp on my legs and rough elbows and it really helps.

In my constant quest for skincare products that deliver real results, I recently tried the AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid. This lotion claims to gently exfoliate, boost cell turnover, and provide deep hydration to uncover softer, smoother skin. Let's dive into my experience with this multi-tasking formula. The lotion is non-greasy and lightweight, making it perfect for daily use. It absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving it feeling soft and hydrated without any heavy residue. The product is fragrance-free, which is a huge plus for those with sensitive skin or a sensitivity to strong scents. The natural smell from the lactic acid salts is subtle and varies slightly depending on your skin's unique pH, but it's not overpowering or unpleasant.

AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid is revolutionary! It provides gentle exfoliation, intense hydration, and results in astonishingly soft and smooth skin. Its lightweight, non-greasy formula ensures lasting moisture throughout the day. Additionally, it is fragrance-free and soothing, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Absolutely adore it!

avis.titre: If you have dry skin, you need this!
avis.texte: I love to use this lotion when my skin feels really dry, especially in the cold months. I also like to use it when my hands when they get super dry. It deeply hydrates my skin.

My daughter suffers from severe dry skin and this is the only product that works wonders for her! It's incredibly light weight and non greasy which is perfect for applying after a shower. Will be repurchasing again!

avis.titre: A must have staple for dry skin
avis.texte: AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid is a must I have in my bag now a day. It helps exfoliates, and deeply hydrates to uncover softer, smoother skin which as a 30ish woman is so needed. I love that it's fragrance free and works with your body.

avis.titre: AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion After-Swim Essential!
avis.texte: I like to think of the AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid AHA as my go-to post-pool or beach essential. It's a lifesaver for my skin, especially after spending hours in the water. My skin tends to get super dry after swimming, and this lotion really comes in handy!

I can't believe it took me so long to find this amazing product. I will have it a part of my skin routine forever now! Such a great lotion for my whole body. Highly recommend purchasing if you have dry and sensitive skin. Game changing product so excited I found it!

As someone with dry and flaky skin, I've tried countless lotions over the years, but none have worked as effectively as this one. The lotion has a rich, creamy texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. My skin feels immediately hydrated and smooth after applying it.

Free from fragrance and gentle formula for us sensitive skin people! My skin is finally starting to show signs of healing after years of not finding the proper formula! Exfoliates gently and boosts my skin! Rejuvenating formula!

I am very picky when it comes to lotion for my skin. I have a dry combo skin and this didn't leave me feeling greasy at all. It made my skin smooth and although it's fragrance free with your PH balance depending on it you get a natural smell that reminds me of being sun kissed. I love this formula!

The AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid is an excellent solution for achieving smoother, healthier skin. This potent formula combines a high concentration of lactic acid with rich moisturizers, providing both exfoliation and deep hydration. Within days of use, my skin felt noticeably softer and more even in texture. It's particularly effective for rough, dry areas, promoting a silky-smooth finish. The non-greasy lotion absorbs quickly, making it ideal for everyday application. For anyone dealing with dry, flaky skin or needing a robust exfoliating moisturizer, this lotion is a must-try. Highly recommended for its transformative results!

avis.titre: Necessary if you want to love your skin!
avis.texte: I absolutely love that fact that this lotion simultaneously provides lightweight and non-greasy moisture while also providing gentle exfoliation! This is exactly what I needed to find this summer when my skin is dried out from the elements, such as sun and chlorine. I feel so much better in my own skin now that I use this Lactic Acid lotion!

I love the 12% lactic acid in this formula! It really does an incredible job of gently exfoliating and leaving skin hydrated. I recently brought it with me to the beach and my skin always gets so dried out from the salty ocean. I also got a little burned and was peeling a bit. This did an incredible job of moisturizing and exfoliating my skin when it was peeling a bit as it healed. ( just a note, I would not use it directly on sunburn skin as the lactic acid might be a little harsh. I used it once it was healed and peeling, it really did an awesome job of exfoliating and restoring my skin.)

The AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid has helped my skin so much! The bumps under my arms disappeared after consistent use. It has brightened my skin tone and after I apply it my skin feels silky smooth! I love that it gently exfoliates and is fragrance free.
For someone who often complains about dry and flaky skin, this has been a game changer. My skin feels more supple, hydrated and moisturized, I use it everyday and it works well on my skin!

AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid is a game-changer! It exfoliates gently, hydrates deeply, and leaves my skin incredibly soft and smooth. It's light, non-greasy, and keeps my skin moisturized all day. Plus, it's fragrance-free and gentle on my skin. Love it!

Being menopausal at a younger age has my skin feeling DRY - all capitals, guys. When the little guys just aren't providing the hydration needed, I love using AmLactin's Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid. It's what I like to call "The Big Guns" as still gently exfoliates but also promote cell turnover and hydrates on a deeper level. Same smooth, lightweight consistency but with a little more bang to it.

avis.titre: Revitalize Your Skin with 12% Lactic Acid
avis.texte: When it comes to skin renewal, I've found my go-to. The main ingredient is the 12% Lactic Acid that gently exfoliates, revealing softer, smoother skin. And the best part? It's lightweight, non-greasy, and keeps my skin moisturized all day long.

This has noticeably improved my skin texture, making it smoother and softer. Super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any greasy residue. Overall, this lotion truly works and has become a staple in my skincare routine.
I love that this lotion helps to exfoliate and hydrate my skin - love dual action! My skin stays soft and hydrated all day. Highly recommend for someone looking for a new daily body lotion.

The AmLactin Daily Nourish Lotion with 12% Lactic Acid is a powerhouse for those tougher dry skin days. This lotion delivers intense hydration and deeper exfoliation, making my skin incredibly smooth and soft. It's a bit more potent, so I use it every other day to maintain my skin's moisture balance without over-exfoliating. The results are noticeable—my skin looks rejuvenated and feels like silk. This product is a must-have for anyone dealing with persistent dryness.
I like the feeling and how it works, but it smells awful. like, my clingy cat wouldn't go anywhere near me after I put it on. I wish they would release a more fragranced one to cover that up

Finally my strawberry skin is gone! I use pretty much every day and it also got rid of dark inner thigh skin. I've tried everything to get rid of strawberry legs n old eczema bumps on the back of my arms and after about a week both are gone. the smell fades as soon as its dry N doesn't clash w/perfume

AHA works wonderfully effective but gentle for my dry and sensitive skin. This is my go to body lotion. A little sticky when first applied but in a while it gets absorbed into the skin. The smell is acceptable to me after long term use. I guess that is a price you pay for the results like any other effective ingredient. So happy Ulta is carrying my favorite body lotion now!!!

Yes this does have a certain smell to it, but compared to how effective it is, ill deal with the smell. It disappears quickly. This has completely transformed my pre-teena acne covered back. I wish they made a face product as effective, but this is too strong to use on your face. HG product at our house.
It amazing its been few weeks i had this big dark spot in my legs i been using this product its fading away.

I have only used the product twice. I cannot yet say if it works, but the smell is not the greatest. It does not linger for very long on the body. I have eczema/dry skin. Again the smell is not favorable.
